title: Bethesda: no big announcements on Skyrim's 15th anniversary and nothing new on Sentinel for some time (report)

sources.note: Insider Gaming 11 Nov: Bethesda Game Studios reply on r/TESVI: 'we aren't going to have any big announcements tomorrow... we will not be sharing anything new on Sentinel for some time'; article says no major updates for a good while

claims.claim: Bethesda replied that there are no big announcements for the Skyrim anniversary
nothing new on Sentinel for some time

gate: gate 17:35Z: Insider read in full, digest 15:26Z and 14:29Z, web search found no denial or other coverage of the reply; Reddit comment not opened; runs as تقرير

angle.why_now: Skyrim turns 15 today and fans expected an Elder Scrolls reveal, but Bethesda replied that nothing big is coming and nothing new on Sentinel for some time; only Insider Gaming reports the reply, the Reddit comment was not opened and no date was given
angle.what_it_means_here: Elder Scrolls fans should not expect Sentinel news soon
angle.payoff: Bethesda will share nothing new on Sentinel for some time

approved: buffer slot 00:15 Dubai 12 Nov (Wed 20:15Z); assignment from Mohammad 11 Nov; report re-checked before it publishes
